import numpy as np, mujoco, rcb_dtb
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
from PIL import Image
class Control:
 def __init__(self,s):
  self.s=s; self.m=s.model; self.d=s.data; self.kd=mujoco.MjData(self.m); self.b=self.m.body('palmleft_hand_C_MC').id
  self.jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv)); self.jr=np.zeros_like(self.jp)
 def pose(self): return self.d.xpos[self.b].copy(), self.d.xmat[self.b].reshape(3,3).copy()
 def ik(self,pos,rot,q=None):
  q=self.s.targets.copy() if q is None else q.copy(); d=self.kd; m=self.m
  d.qpos[:]=self.d.qpos
  for _ in range(90):
   d.qpos[self.s._jq]=q; mujoco.mj_kinematics(m,d); mujoco.mj_comPos(m,d)
   e=np.r_[pos-d.xpos[self.b],Rot.from_matrix(rot@d.xmat[self.b].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec()]
   if np.linalg.norm(e)<1e-5:break
   mujoco.mj_jacBody(m,d,self.jp,self.jr,self.b)
   J=np.r_[self.jp[:,self.s._jv[:7]],self.jr[:,self.s._jv[:7]]]
   dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.eye(6)*1e-5,e)
   q[:7]+=dq*min(1,.12/(np.max(np.abs(dq))+1e-9)); q=np.clip(q,self.s.lower,self.s.upper)
  return q
 def move(self,pos,rot=None,hand=None,n=120):
  p0,r0=self.pose(); rot=r0 if rot is None else rot; q0=self.s.targets.copy(); rv=Rot.from_matrix(rot@r0.T).as_rotvec()
  for i in range(n):
   t=(i+1)/n; a=t*t*(3-2*t); p=p0+(pos-p0)*a; r=Rot.from_rotvec(rv*a).as_matrix()@r0
   q=self.ik(p,r)
   if hand is not None:q[7:]=q0[7:]*(1-a)+hand*a
   self.s.step(q)
 def hold(self,n=60):
  for i in range(n):self.s.step(self.s.targets)
 def snap(self,name):
  Image.fromarray(self.s.render_grid(size=(640,480))).save('/app/output/'+name+'.png')
 def info(self,label):
  print(label,'t',self.s.steps,'obj',self.d.xpos[self.s._obj], 'palm',self.pose()[0], 'progress',self.s.progress(),flush=True)
 def contacts(self):
  for con in self.d.contact:
   b1,b2=self.m.geom_bodyid[con.geom1],self.m.geom_bodyid[con.geom2]
   if self.s._obj in [b1,b2]:
    f=np.zeros(6);mujoco.mj_contactForce(self.m,self.d,list(self.d.contact).index(con),f)
    print(self.m.geom(con.geom1).name,self.m.geom(con.geom2).name,con.dist,f[:3])

def hand(amt=1.5,thumb=None):
 q=np.zeros(22);q[:5]=[amt,0,.6*amt,0,.7*amt] if thumb is None else thumb
 for st in [5,9,13,18]:q[st:st+4]=[amt,0,amt,.6*amt]
 return q
